flashcard_questions.q: Using the fewest possible elements to achieve the desired effect, allowing quick character transitions and keeping the audience focused on the actors' skills.
Pieces of furniture or set that can serve multiple purposes during a performance, changing their meaning depending on how they are used.
Small hand-held objects used on stage to help distinguish characters, establish setting, or aid the audience in suspending disbelief.

flashcard_questions.a: A broad spread of light covering a large area of the stage, used to create atmosphere or establish a general mood.
A metal template placed in front of a light source to project a pattern or shape onto the stage, such as leaves, windows, or prison bars.
